photos.name: img-7657
photos.summary: Six pale-gold cookies spaced on parchment-lined sheet pan, fresh from the oven. Chocolate chips and chunks dot the tops, flaky salt visible, edges set but color is light.

photos.name: img-7659
photos.summary: Six cookies plated on a white round plate, two mugs in the dim background (brown mug, yellow 'Your Turntable's Not Dead' enamel mug). Domed shape, light golden color, chocolate chunks and chips with flaky salt on top.

photos.name: img-7663
photos.summary: Four cookies on a copper wire cooling rack, stovetop and Vitamin canister in the background. Darker, more amber color than the night batch, chocolate chunks and chips visible with flaky salt.
